# Feature / Improvement

Thanks for helping improve Elrik's C&C Roll20 Character Sheet.

Ideas are welcome, whether they are new features, workflow improvements, quality-of-life changes, or simply a better way of presenting information.

## What would you like changed or added?

Describe the feature or improvement.

## Why would this be useful?

Tell us what problem it solves or how it would make the sheet easier to use during play.

## Where would it belong?

If applicable, identify the area of the sheet.

Examples: Core, Combat, Inventory, Magic, Abilities, Tools, Help, Character Creation.

## How do you imagine it working?

Describe the behaviour you would expect as a player or Castle Keeper.

You do not need to provide technical implementation details.

## Is this based on a C&C rule?

Yes / No / Not sure

If yes, please provide the source book, printing/edition, and page number when possible.

## Additional Information

Add screenshots, examples, mock-ups, or anything else that helps explain the idea.
